# s1196 black-box behavior contract

This contract covers deterministic two-state inputs and complete native behavior. Inputs are stable within observation windows; state depends only on reset and input history.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-001 Asynchronous reset

When blif_reset_net=1, all abstract state bits q0..q17 become zero asynchronously. Active-high reset dominates the clock.

A reset pulse between edges clears state immediately; releasing reset does not update state.

Reset does not force every output to zero. Combinational outputs use the zero state and current inputs.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-002 Parallel next-state update

At each non-reset rising blif_clk_net edge, update all q0..q17 from the next-state roots listed below, using the same old state and G0..G13 inputs for every bit.

Only rising edges update state. Falling edges and intervals without a rising edge preserve it.

The 18 state bits update in parallel, without cascading same-edge updates. There is no valid/busy handshake.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-003 Direct state outputs

G45=q16 and G546=NOT q12.

These outputs reflect state after reset or a state transition has settled.

Reset guarantees G45=0 and G546=1.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-004 Combinational output group 1

G539,G550,G551,G552 use the output roots listed below. F0=0 and F1=1. Recursively choose each node's low or high branch according to its variable.

Variables v0..v13 are current G0..G13; v14..v31 are q0..q17. Outputs respond combinationally without waiting for a clock edge.

All two-state values follow the tables, rather than reset-only or constant behavior.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-005 Combinational output group 2

G547,G548,G549 use the roots listed below. Variable value 0 selects the low branch and 1 selects the high branch.

Evaluate from current inputs and current settled state.

These outputs are not clock-registered.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-006 Combinational output group 3

G530,G542,G532 use the listed roots and current state/current inputs.

They respond combinationally between edges.

Shared functions may affect several outputs; compare each output separately.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-007 Combinational output group 4

G535,G537 use the listed roots with the same branch-selection semantics and no additional mode.

While reset is high, combinational outputs use all-zero state and current inputs.

All-zero, all-one, one-hot, one-cold, and random input combinations are legal.

## R-D82FE92CBEE6-008 Two-state observations without a handshake

The interface has a clock, reset, and 14 data inputs, with no parameters, ready, valid, or enable. All 14 outputs are observable in every stable window.

Compare after input changes settle, after rising-edge NBA updates settle, after falling edges, and after reset pulses between edges. Unknown state before the first reset is outside the scored domain.

Infer abstract state from reset and input history; internal DUT access is unnecessary.

## Boolean function contract

All functions are two-state. Abstract q bits reset to zero and are not DUT internal signal names. The variable mapping is defined above.

F0=0,F1=1. A node selects its low-function branch when its variable is 0 and its high-function branch when 1. These are mathematical functions, not implementation netlist or timing constraints.
